description:
The sales clerks in a bank can use their software frontend to receive the credit-scoring for a certain customer. 
This starts a process in the banking system which communicates with the agency in the background. 
This process sends a scoring request to the agency right after the beginning. 
Then, the Agency does a first quick scoring (level 1). 
This will often lead to an immediate result which is then returned directly to the banking system within seconds. 
The banking process presents the result to the clerk sitting at the frontend. 
Sometimes the scoring cannot be determined immediately and takes longer. 
In this case the agency informs the banking process of the delay and then starts the level 2 scoring (which can take up to a couple of minutes). 
After the scoring result is determined, the information is sent back to the banking process. 
The banking process displays a message to the clerk when he receives information about the delay to check again later. 
As soon as the result arrives, it can be seen at the frontend.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/banking-credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DelayNotice" name="Scoring delay notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringResult" name="Scoring result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FrontendDelay" name="Delay message for frontend"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FrontendResult" name="Scoring result for frontend"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Frontend" name="Sales clerk frontend"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_BankingSystem" name="Banking system" processRef="Process_Banking"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FrontendRequest" name="Scoring request" sourceRef="Participant_Frontend" targetRef="Start_ScoringRequested" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BankRequest" name="Scoring request" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Start_AgencyRequest" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayNotice" name="Scoring delay notice" sourceRef="Task_SendDelay" targetRef="Event_CatchDelay" messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ImmediateResult" name="Scoring result" sourceRef="Task_SendResult" targetRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Level2Result" name="Scoring result" sourceRef="Task_SendResult" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FrontendDelay" name="Delay message" sourceRef="Task_DisplayDelay" targetRef="Participant_Frontend" messageRef="Message_FrontendDelay"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FrontendResult" name="Scoring result" sourceRef="Task_PresentResult" targetRef="Participant_Frontend" messageRef="Message_FrontendResult"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Banking" name="Banking credit-scoring process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ScoringRequested" name="Scoring requested from frontend">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ScoringRequest" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" name="Wait for agency response" gatewayDirection="Diverging" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchImmediateResult" name="Receive immediate scoring result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchDelay" name="Receive scoring delay notice">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DelayNotice" messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DisplayDelay" name="Display delay message at frontend" messageRef="Message_FrontendDelay"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchLevel2Result" name="Receive level 2 scoring result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Level2Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeResults" name="Merge scoring result paths" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PresentResult" name="Present scoring result at frontend" messageRef="Message_FrontendResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ResultPresented" name="Scoring result presented at frontend"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_1" sourceRef="Start_ScoringRequested" targetRef="Task_SendRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_2" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_3" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_4" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_CatchDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_5" sourceRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult" targetRef="Gateway_MergeResults"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_6" sourceRef="Event_CatchDelay" targetRef="Task_DisplayDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_7" sourceRef="Task_DisplayDelay" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_8" sourceRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result" targetRef="Gateway_MergeResults"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_9" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeResults" targetRef="Task_PresentResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_10" sourceRef="Task_PresentResult" targetRef="End_ResultPresented"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Agency credit-scoring process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_AgencyRequest" name="Scoring request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_AgencyRequest" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ImmediateDecision" name="Can the result be determined immediately?" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDelay" name="Inform banking system of scoring delay" messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeScoringPaths" name="Merge scoring paths" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendResult" name="Send scoring result to banking system" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ResultSent" name="Scoring result sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_1" sourceRef="Start_AgencyRequest" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_2" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_ImmediateDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_3" name="Result determined immediately" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateDecision" targetRef="Gateway_MergeScoringPaths">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">resultDeterminedImmediately</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_4" name="Scoring takes longer" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateDecision" targetRef="Task_SendDelay">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">resultNotDeterminedImmediately</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_5" sourceRef="Task_SendDelay" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_6" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_MergeScoringPaths"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_7" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeScoringPaths" targetRef="Task_SendResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_8" sourceRef="Task_SendResult" targetRef="End_ResultSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
